01
洗錢：犯罪得益及三個階段
Money laundering: criminal proceeds and three stages

tableRoles.name: 概念 Concept
資金來源 Origin
核心問題 Core concern
法律條件 Legal conditions
洗錢（ML） Money laundering (ML)
犯罪得益 Criminal proceeds
犯罪得益的來源被掩飾。 Disguises the criminal origin of proceeds.
財產可全部／部分、直接／間接代表得益；境外行為若在港會屬可公訴罪行也可涵蓋。 Property may represent proceeds wholly/partly, directly/indirectly; overseas conduct that would be indictable in Hong Kong may be covered.
恐怖分子資金籌集（TF） Terrorist financing (TF)
合法或非法 Lawful or unlawful
合法或非法來源均可能涉及；看用途、對象及法定心理要素。 Lawful or unlawful funds may be involved; purpose, recipient and statutory mental elements matter.

供恐怖行為使用的財產須有意圖或知情，不必實際使用；向恐怖分子／聯繫者提供或為其籌集時，知道或罔顧對方身分均可涵蓋。 Property for terrorist acts requires intent/knowledge, not actual use. Relevant provision/collection for a terrorist/associate covers knowledge or recklessness about that status.
擴散融資（PF） Proliferation financing (PF)
不可只憑來源判斷 Origin alone is not decisive
服務可能協助大規模毀滅武器及其運載方式。 Services may assist WMD and their means of delivery.
有合理理由相信或懷疑服務可能涉及PF便可能觸犯第526章；適用制裁禁令另須遵守。 Cap.526 covers belief or suspicion on reasonable grounds that services may be connected to PF; applicable sanctions prohibitions also apply.
概念／情境 Concept / situation
必記區別 Remember the distinction
條件及例外 Conditions and exceptions
FATF：呼籲採取行動 FATF: call for action
相稱的加強盡職審查；指定情況另有反制措施。 Proportionate EDD; countermeasures in specified cases.
按有關聲明及海關通函區分；具體地區名單保留通函日期，不能當作永久名單。 Distinguish the applicable statement/circular. Country lists are dated snapshots, not permanent lists.
FATF：加強監察 FATF: increased monitoring
納入客戶整體風險評估。 Factor into the overall customer risk assessment.
單憑列名不會自動令每宗客戶關係必須EDD。 Listing alone does not automatically require EDD for every customer relationship.
受指定人士／實體制裁 Designated-person/entity sanctions
依法凍結及禁止提供／處理資產等。 Statutory freezing and prohibitions on availability/dealing.
不能用「低風險」取代法定禁止；只有適用豁免／有效特許才可在其範圍內行事。 A low-risk rating does not override a prohibition; only act within applicable exemptions/valid licences.

01
客戶盡職審查：定義及四項措施
Customer due diligence: definition and four measures

tableRoles.name: 身分類別 Status category
何時適用共同加強措施 When the common enhanced measures apply
條件 Conditions
非香港PEP Non-Hong Kong PEP
客戶／BO屬非香港PEP Customer / BO is a non-Hong Kong PEP
包括客戶或其BO；並非三選一。現有關係後來才發現PEP身分也須處理。 Covers customer/BO; these are not alternatives. Later discovery within an existing relationship also requires action.
香港／國際組織PEP Hong Kong / international-organisation PEP
關係屬高風險 The relationship is high risk

建立時高風險、後來變高風險，或高風險關係後來發現PEP身分均涵蓋；本地PEP不自動一律高風險。 Covers high risk at establishment, later becoming high risk, or PEP discovery in a high-risk relationship. Domestic status is not universally high risk.
概念／情境 Concept / situation
必記區別 Remember the distinction
條件及例外 Conditions and exceptions
依賴合資格中介人 Reliance on a qualifying intermediary
中介人通常有獨立的既有客戶關係及程序。 The intermediary usually has an existing independent customer relationship/procedures.
須合資格、書面同意、立即取得CDD資料並可按要求無延誤取得支持文件；MSO責任不轉移。 Eligibility, written consent, immediate CDD data and supporting-record availability without delay are required; MSO liability remains.
外判／代理 Outsourcing / agency
按MSO程序及其控制執行。 Acts under the MSO’s procedures/control.
與法定中介人依賴不同；不能因此移轉CDD責任。第5條持續監察仍由MSO負責。 Different from statutory reliance; CDD liability is not transferred. Schedule 2 s.5 ongoing monitoring remains with the MSO.
